title: A planner run started with --plan-turns writes round 0 in turns of one conversation; without it nothing changes
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: Turn 1 is the run's own first message plus what the turn decides (site, mainMenu, sharedBlocks); each later turn plans one page group in kit order, as the next user message of the same conversation.
The turns merge into one plan in the shape of a whole answer, checked once; the fix round continues the same conversation.
After each group's turn, reading.turnChecks holds the page-local failures located in that group, and nothing of the whole site.
A resumed round never sends a turn's message twice.
Without planTurns the planner sends the same requests, byte for byte, as a step with no turn hooks; a writer-style step still opens a fresh conversation per turn.
--plan-turns beside --parallel-pages above 1 is refused with SITE_PLANNER_BAD_PLAN_TURNS.

tests: a run plans in turns only when it was started with planTurns
turn 1 starts from the run first message and plans the whole site
the turns merge into the plan a whole answer would hold
a group turn's check keeps the page-local failures located in that group
every way the check names a place is read
a run started with planTurns writes round 0 as turns of one conversation
a group turn that breaks a page-local rule is recorded
a round 0 resumed after a turn was answered but not recorded
a later turn dispatched and never answered
without planTurns round 0 sends the same requests, byte for byte
a step whose turns are requests of their own (the writer)
plan turns cannot start beside parallel pages above 1
